reply_text:
Gideon, you first reported the kiosks offline at 10:42 AM on 3 Aug in this channel. The message said both inbound lanes showed a white screen after badge scan.

While the kiosks were down, the guard wrote trailer numbers on a clipboard. At 10:44 Mateo said six trucks were waiting at the east gate.

Kiosk 1 came back at 11:03. That's when the guard checked in trailer 8836 and dispatch saw it. You confirmed both lanes working as of 11:07, so the outage ran about 25 minutes.
